Hi Naomi / Laura,

Thanks for starting the onboarding with Acme. Procurement is ready to route a purchase order, but before we can open the PO we need the standard vendor compliance packet from Redwood:

- Signed DPA (or DPA template and confirmation you accept our standard DPA)
- Latest SOC 2 report (redacted link is fine)
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV or spreadsheet)
- Confirmation of data retention policy for customer data
- Billing contact and remit instructions (we use our PO number on invoices)

Can you send these by EOD Tuesday? Also confirm whether Redwood can accept a PO with Net45 payment terms and whether we should include the PO number in the invoice subject or a specific invoice field.

Thanks —

Hi all,

Attaching the items Acme requested. Summary below and next steps.

1) DPA: attached redwood_dpa_v1.3.pdf. This is our standard DPA with the usual protections and limited edits accepted. We can sign Acme's DPA with one change: we need the liability cap to remain in line with our standard (aggregate cap equals fees paid in 12 months). If Acme's procurements team requires a different cap, legal will need to review redlines — that will delay timeline.

2) SOC 2: shared secure link below (redacted report). We only provide the report via our secure S3 link to verified contacts — link included for Megan.

3) Subprocessors: subprocessor_inventory_2027-04.csv attached. It includes host, telemetry, analytics, and CDN partners; column notes at the bottom.

4) Data retention: Redwood keeps customer prompt/response data for 30 days by default for routing/observability, longer only by customer configuration — we documented that in the DPA (section 4) and in the vendor onboarding questionnaire. If Acme requires a stricter retention policy we can offer a custom retention SLA on a Dedicated or Private deployment.

5) PO terms: We can accept PO Net45 in most enterprise deals; billing ops prefers Net30 but will accept Net45 if Acme signs the DPA and completes the vendor form. Please confirm the billing contact (name/email) in Acme's reply and whether they will include PO number on the invoice subject.

DocuSign link (for Acme): https://docusign.example.com/txn/12345ABC
SOC2 link (redacted): https://s3.redwood-inference.com/reports/soc2-redacted-2026.pdf

Attachments: redwood_dpa_v1.3.pdf (PDF, 15 pages), subprocessor_inventory_2027-04.csv (CSV, 1.2 MB)

Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.com

Hi Naomi / Priyom,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the documentation. I received the DPA and the SOC 2 link — we can download the redacted report from the S3 link and will share with internal audit. The subprocessor CSV looks good at a glance; we'll reconcile internally and may follow up with one question about a telemetry vendor.

A few confirmations from our side:
- Billing contact for Acme will be accounts.payable@acmecorp.com and PO numbers will appear in the invoice subject line.
- Net45 is acceptable for this deal.
- We'll route the DPA for signature via the DocuSign link you provided; expect signatures from legal by Friday.

Please note: our DPO copied here may request a minor clarification on data retention in section 4 (just to confirm deletion timelines for debug logs). If that comes through we may ask for a one-line clarification rather than redlining the DPA.

Once DocuSign completes and we receive an invoice referencing PO ACME-7921, Procurement will issue the PO and billing will process Net45.

Best,
Megan Lin
